assessment_objectives.objective: the types of sensitive and/or regulated data that, when processed, stored or transmitted by a system, require individuals accessing the system to meet citizenship requirements are defined.

the citizenship requirements, derived from applicable statutory, regulatory and/or contractual requirements, to be met by individuals accessing a system processing, storing or transmitting sensitive and/or regulated data are defined.
individuals accessing a system processing, storing or transmitting sensitive and/or regulated data are verified to meet the defined citizenship requirements.
